architecture.subtitle: 100% serverless, zero cold-starts, globally distributed on Cloudflare Workers and PostgreSQL.
architecture.calloutRest: We've already handled the hard parts so you can focus on building your idea.

useCases.title: What Can You Build with NuxFire?
useCases.subtitle: Most SaaS boilerplates break the moment you need stateful WebSockets, async job queues, or true enterprise multi-tenancy. NuxFire is engineered to carry your project from day-one MVP all the way to millions of daily requests without refactoring your core architecture.

b2b.title: B2B SaaS & Team Workspaces
b2b.description: Sell subscription tiers with per-seat or workspace billing. Strict tenant isolation, tokenized team invitations, and fine-grained role-based access control (RBAC) are fully audited and production-ready on day one.
b2b.superpower: Native teams layer, nuxt-authorization, Stripe Checkout/Portal, and integrated Kanban layer.

realtime.title: Stateful Realtime Applications
realtime.description: Build multiplayer collaborative apps without expensive Redis clusters or dedicated Socket.io servers. Each room or channel operates in an isolated Cloudflare Durable Object backed by low-latency embedded SQLite.
realtime.superpower: Durable Objects with SQLite storage, HMAC-signed ticket handshake, and sub-50ms global edge latency.

ai.title: AI Platforms & Autonomous Agents
ai.description: Execute long-running LLM completions and heavy compute without blocking the UI or hitting HTTP request timeouts. Cloudflare Queues process async jobs with exponential backoff and Dead Letter Queue capture.
ai.superpower: Cloudflare Queues with DLQ, unlimited R2 storage with zero egress fees, and live updates via WebSockets.

micro.title: Micro-SaaS & Membership Portals
micro.description: Ship lean, highly profitable subscription tools in a single weekend. OpenAuth.js authentication runs in Cloudflare KV with zero database connection overhead, and Nuxt Content v3 provides lightning-fast documentation and blogs.
micro.superpower: OpenAuth with zero-DB sessions, D1 SQL Full-Text Search, and pre-configured Stripe Billing.

enterprise.title: Client Portals & Internal Backoffices
enterprise.description: Deliver self-service portals and operational backoffices that pass stringent corporate security audits. Comes standard with a dedicated Super-Admin console, TOTP Multi-Factor Authentication, and full audit logging.
enterprise.superpower: Isolated /admin portal with TOTP MFA, audit_logs table in PostgreSQL, and end-to-end type safety.

api.title: High-Scale APIs & Event Pipelines
api.description: Process millions of webhooks and background jobs with near-zero idle infrastructure cost. Hyperdrive connection pooling accelerates PostgreSQL queries without connection exhaustion, and transactional emails handle failovers.
api.superpower: Cloudflare Hyperdrive TCP connection pooling, multi-provider React Email (Resend/Brevo/SES), and edge Crons.
